findings.independent_observation: Store.ensure rolled staging back before its bounded failure record, deleting .provision-stderr and losing original failed-stage stderr.
findings.resolution: resolved-in-source: failure() performs the private maker handoff before exit; Store, STORE_PY, STORE_VERIFY, and the public marker schema are unchanged.
findings.regression: actual isolated Store.ensure cleanup boundary passed for nonzero and timeout stages; retained payload remained after staging deletion.
